description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator class, which provides additional methods to format, retrieve, and decorate properties of EmployeeImmigrationRecord entities related to employee immigration details within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides formatted access and additional functionalities for EmployeeImmigrationRecord entities, including date formatting, country name retrieval, and setting employee references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeImmigrationRecord object.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying EmployeeImmigrationRecord object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee object for the immigration record based on an employee number.

methods.name: getIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the issued date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Returns the review date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getCountryName
methods.description: Retrieves the country name associated with the immigration record's country code, via CountryService.

methods.name: getDocumentType
methods.description: Returns the document type mapped from the record's type, or null if not recognized.
